args.prompt:
Create a new KFB claymation ink blob monster sheet for The Küsnacht Seminar, C. G. Jung and analytical psychology. Supplied original images are style references for soft full continuous charcoal-plum ink blob shapes and handcrafted props. Six individually distinct complete upright footless blobs in three columns and two rows, landscape 1536x1024, true transparent PNG. Equal substantial scale, generous clear transparent gutters and margins, all props inside the cell and attached or held. Thick rounded goo bodies, short ink hands, distinct facial shapes and expressions, ivory white sclera, red iris and black pupil, filled modeled eyelids, teeth behind lips. Large soft modeling marks, gentle satin plasticine with very sparse fine grain, broad fabric folds, clear glass and smooth plastic. Keep dominant ink bodies and period or symbolic accessories small. No copied wings, eyepatches or reference costumes. No floor, scene, text, labels, shadows, frame, branding, graphic distress or caricature of illness. Gentle surreal satire of habits, theory and bureaucracy. Color and craft direction: Ink red, muted ochre, old leather, forest green and shallow engraved details. Row-major cast:
1. Male-read inquisitive historical analyst. round wire spectacles, swept gray clay hair, compact tweed collar, red folio. low squared blob, intent gaze and slight smile.
2. Female-read meticulous image recorder. small red folio open to one simple painted circle. tall lean droplet, downturned focused eyes and compressed lips.
3. Male-read startled coincidence collector. two matching pocket watches in one hand, simple cases. round off-balance blob, enormous pupils and small gasp.
4. Female-read pensive stone carver. palm-sized blunt stone block and stubby chisel. upright comma, downcast eyes, pursed lip.
5. Male-read curious active-imagination participant. one tiny colorful clay bird figurine in cupped hands. asymmetric low pear, lifted look, quiet open smile.
6. Male-read overzealous pattern finder. wood tray with four colored clay quadrants. high scalloped blob, intent asymmetric gaze and narrow gritted smile.
Exactly six unique freestanding cutouts. Make the main motif of each slot legible at small sizes.

material_change: Gentle charcoal/plum satin clay with broader sparse surface marks and smoother liquid, plastic and glass props.
